In the heart of rural Ontario, experience tremendous work-life balance combined with opportunities to reach your career goals – whatever they may be.

What You Can Expect:

* Balance:  Realize your full potential without sacrificing personal and family life balance.  Enjoy flex time throughout the year and reasonable core hours. 

* Professional Development: We are a CPA training facility and you’ll be supported on your path to achieving your designation. You’ll be challenged with a broad range of tasks and receive ongoing development through experience, mentoring and formal education.  

* Opportunity:  Your goals aren’t too big for us! You’ll find opportunity at all levels, right to Partner if that’s how big you dream.

* Compensation:  Enjoy a highly competitive compensation package, including benefits, RRSP contributions, overtime pay, an abundance of time off and a generous profit share plan.

* Social: You’ll have the chance to experience our “Work Hard, Play Hard” mantra. Our team enjoys several company social events throughout the year, team dinners and lots of treats during tax season, too.

* Culture: Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere with open-door policies. Chat with partners in the lunchroom, and foster relationships that will help you through life and your career.

* Lifestyle:  You can enjoy small town, affordable living or an easy drive from Waterloo. Depuis maintenant plus de 75 ans, nous offrons des services spécialisés aux entreprises et aux particuliers. Nos services comprennent la certification, la fiscalité, les services-conseils financiers et d’affaires, les crédits d’impôt RS&DE, l’aide aux PME et aux OBNL, ainsi que les ressources humaines.

PSB BOISJOLI est un membre indépendant de PrimeGlobal, la 3e plus grande association de cabinets comptables indépendants au monde.

Le cabinet est fier d’être associé à Solertia, l’une des principales firmes de conseil intégré en gestion des ressources humaines au Québec.  Cette firme est dotée d’une équipe multidisciplinaire qui offre les services suivants aux PME et aux grandes entreprises : équité salariale, rémunération, loi du 1%, recrutement stratégique, gestion de la performance, et plus encore.

*****************************************************************************************

Montreal-based PSB BOISJOLI, LLP is one of Quebec’s leading accounting firms with a team of more than 200 people. 

For over 75 years, we have offered specialized services to companies and individuals. Our services include: Assurance, Taxation, Financial and Business Advisory services, SR & ED, Small Business Assistance, Human Resources and Not-for-Profit Organizations.

PSB BOISJOLI, LLP is an independent member firm of PrimeGlobal, the third-largest association of independent accounting firms in the world.  

PSB BOISJOLI, LLP is also proud to be affiliated with Solertia, one of the leading Human Resources Consulting Firms in Quebec.
